notes.title: Bug fix
notes.content:
I apologize for the inconvenience.

Fixed a bug where progression from the second day of Rogue-like mode was not possible in some environments.

notes.title: patch contents
notes.content:
Modified the hourglass effect to only count towards card usage.
Corrected some notation errors.
Fixed English subtitle errors.

notes.title: update
notes.content:
Some relics effects have been improved and adjusted.
Some card notation errors have been corrected.

notes.title: Update details:
notes.content:
Update details:
-Slightly reduced memory usage.
-Added a 'Redraw' feature in the card acquisition window after battles.
-Modified some defense cards and added defense-related skills.
-Added 3 new defense-related cards.
-Artifact limit set to 12 (no issues with existing save files).
-Fixed some errors occurring when transitioning from Story Mode to Roguelike Mode.
-Adjusted Story Mode events and balance.
-Basic hit rate increased to 95%.
-Combo card cost increased.

notes.title: Fixes
notes.content:
Story mode boss buff fix
Fixed some bugs such as text notation pharmacy skill book UI

notes.title: Bug fixes and addition of option to save.
notes.content:
Fixed a bug where the combat was being skipped in the 'Very Hard' difficulty.

Modified to save the sound and text option values.

notes.title: Bug fixes and numerical adjustments
notes.content:
Fixed an issue when purchasing multiple random boxes at the pharmacy
Move the popup window to the front when acquiring artifact skills
Fixed font overlapping in the skill acquisition window
Adjusted effects of some artifacts and skills

notes.title: bug fix
notes.content:
Fixed an error where the next difficulty level could not be progressed after clearing the Roguelike mode
Roguelike mode 'Bleeding Expert' quest infinitely completed bug fix

notes.title: Bug fixes and feature additions
notes.content:
Added
- Modified to display reinforcement information when clicking on a card in the card acquisition window

Edited
- Arranged some UI
- Fix double copying error when using 'Duplicate' card multiple times
- Modified card not to draw additionally due to redraw/contemplation when using 'Hero Pose'

notes.title: bug and balance patch
notes.content:
Fixed some bugs and card balance
Starting hit rate 85% -> modified to 90%
To get 5% hit rate from an existing save file, load the game and press F1 (except for roguelikes).

notes.title: bug fix
notes.content:
-Fixed an error where the screen shakes even when the hit effect is turned off
- Limit level 50 -> modified to 70

notes.title: bug fix
notes.content:
-Fixed some errors when loading
-Block the save function in the gambling house (only auto save is supported)
-Fixed the movement of the health bar when hit

-Tear gas poisoning level nerfed from 15 to 13
- Poison gas poisoning level nerfed from 15 to 14
-Poison explosion damage 4x -> 3x nerf

notes.title: BUG FIX
notes.content:
- Inventory item overlap/item copy bug fixed
- Fixed UI overlap error
- Fixed the problem that the pawnshop card removal window does not open again when closed
- Fixed an error where only one card appears when re-entering the card acquisition reward window
-Fixed a bug that increased enemy health and status when certain keys were pressed
-Fixed an error where the pharmacy's passive skill did not respond
-Fixed an error that clicked when clicking on a skill equipped in the skill window
- Limited to 5 gambling places
